Your holdings: SOXL is still in the red (-56.25%) and flagged for attention. SMH (-13.08%) and QQQI (-3.33%) are also flagged for trimming. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on oil prices and any related inflation data. Also, monitor the semiconductor sector for any signs of stabilization or further weakness.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and protecting your capital in this volatile environment.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming this leveraged position further given the significant unrealized loss and decay risk.
SMH: Evaluate trimming this position to reduce exposure, especially if it breaks below your stop of 540.
QQQI: Consider trimming this position if it continues to drift lower, to preserve capital.
